style: Avant-garde art-rock chamber pop, trashy theatrical delivery. Harmony: prime-limit lattice quartal suspension fields, polyharmonic layers, no tonic resolution, microtonal inflection drifts. Melody: angular vocal patter, consonantal nucleus rhythm, obsessive Tashlhiyt-Hungarian vowel mechanics, pitch-class set iterations. Rhythm: co-prime cycle interlock 5:7:11, gradual phase shift, double-time hallucination, asymmetric metric modulation. Timbre: Kamancheh, DTMF touch-tones, shift-register noise, Clavioline, contact-mic table, Cuatro, bowed springs. Performance: obsessive fixation, high-kinetic energy, pinball register ricochets, antiphonal choir counterpoint, breathless hocket delivery. Production: dry, close-miked micro-transients, concentric ring spatialization, dynamic spectral gating. Form: event-driven hard interrupts, perpetual uplift breakthroughs, recursive motivic splicing. Stemminess: high register separation, dry discrete stereo scattering, multi-bus phase correlation.

caption: A high-velocity, antiphonally structured chamber-art experiment. The piece uses prime-limit lattice tuning and co-prime rhythmic interlocks to create a constant sense of upward tension without tonic resolution. The vocal system applies Tashlhiyt-inspired phonological constraints—vowel starvation and consonant nuclei—turning the English text into a rhythmic, percussive lattice. Trashy performance TONE meets obsessive structural fixation, resulting in a fractured, high-kinetic musical event.
